title: [tenmin-gate] hasSealedMarker: characterization test for empty, non-dispatch and mixed run lists
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for hasSealedMarker in src/tenmin-gate.ts: sealed marker edges
- hasSealedMarker([]) is false
- hasSealedMarker([{ id: 1, status: "completed", conclusion: "success", head_branch: "main", event: "schedule", display_title: "One-off ten-minute fetch: sealed (post-seal)" }]) is false
- hasSealedMarker([{ id: 1, status: "completed", conclusion: "success", head_branch: "main", event: "workflow_dispatch" }]) is false
- hasSealedMarker([{ id: 1, status: "completed", conclusion: "failure", head_branch: "main", event: "workflow_dispatch", display_title: "x" }, { id: 2, status: "completed", conclusion: "success", head_branch: "main", event: "workflow_dispatch", display_title: "One-off ten-minute fetch: sealed (post-seal)" }]) is true

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v4): Peace's task (source: peace). hasSealedMarker is tested by varying one field of a single sealed run (status, conclusion, branch, title); an empty list, a schedule event, a missing display title and a sealed run behind a failed one are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS ef9778e (Workspace main 3670cd8, live 27-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v4); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with hasSealedMarker stubbed); suite 598/598 with all thirteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
